Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > 1. Overview

Digital Savings Synergy App (SdMAUI) is a customer-facing mobile application designed to

make savings, merchant offers, digital gift-card activity, and member engagement accessible

from one guided experience. The application brings together discovery, location-aware

browsing, offer saving, redemption-related journeys, membership, and support content in a

single mobile workspace.

The app is built for consumers who want to find relevant offers, explore participating locations,

manage their saved interests, use digital value, and stay connected with the service. Its

experience combines a simple entry point with a broader set of self-service and engagement

features available after sign-in.

Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > 2. Business Context

Customers looking for savings and merchant benefits typically need to move between

discovery, location search, offer details, saved items, payment or gift-card actions, and

account support. When these steps are fragmented, users can lose context and businesses

have fewer opportunities to sustain engagement.

The SdMAUI application centralizes these touchpoints in a mobile-first experience. It supports

a clear progression from access and onboarding through offer discovery, selection, saving,

location exploration, digital value management, and continued engagement.

Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > 4. Functional Modules

4.1 Secure Access & Onboarding

Users begin at a focused welcome screen with options to log in or join. The application also

provides password recovery and password-update journeys, helping users regain access and

complete account setup without leaving the mobile experience.

4.2 Discover Offers & Savings

●Browse offer listings and open a dedicated offer details experience for the full description and

available actions.

●Use search and filtering controls to narrow the offer experience to more relevant results.

4.3 Location-Based Discovery

Location-aware features connect offer discovery with physical places. Map views, location

details, pin imagery, and location services support a more practical experience for users who

want to understand where an offer or participating merchant can be found.

●View participating locations through map-based screens and location details.

●Use device location capabilities to support nearby discovery and geofenced engagement

scenarios.

●Move from a location or map view into relevant offer and merchant information.

4.4 Saved Offers, Favorites & Alerts

Users can keep the offers that matter to them close at hand. Favorite and saved-offer areas

provide a return path to previously selected content, while notifications and saving-alert

screens support ongoing awareness of offer activity.

4.5 Gift Cards, Payments & Redemption

The application includes customer journeys for adding a credit or debit card, loading a digital

gift card, viewing gift-card activity, entering gift-card details, and reviewing redemption history.

These capabilities connect savings discovery with the digital value that a customer can

manage and use.

4.6 Membership & Subscription Experience

Subscription screens provide a dedicated place for membership-related actions and status.

4.7 Support, Content & Referrals

●Provide FAQ and informational pages to answer common questions and explain the service.

●Expose contact and about-us content for customer support and company context.

●Present terms of use and privacy information through dedicated content experiences.

●Support referral and friend-sharing journeys that help customers introduce the service to others.

●Include an in-app chat entry point and web-backed content experiences where appropriate.

4.8 Profile & App Preferences

Account and preference areas give users a place to manage personal information, address

details, billing address information, language selection, settings, and sign-out. Notification

inbox and message-detail experiences provide a further self-service path for staying informed.

Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > 6. Engagement & Insights

The application is designed to keep the customer journey visible and actionable across

several engagement surfaces:

●Offer browsing and saved-offer areas help users return to opportunities they have already

considered.

●Map and location experiences connect digital discovery with real-world merchant visits.

●Notifications, inbox views, and alerts create a channel for timely customer communication.

●Gift-card and redemption history screens give users a clearer view of digital value activity.

●Subscription and account settings make membership and preferences easier to manage.

●FAQ, contact, about-us, privacy, and terms content supports self-service and trust.

Together, these areas create a connected mobile experience rather than a single-purpose

offer catalogue. The application supports discovery, decision-making, action, and return

engagement within one product journey.

Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > Our Contribution

Based on the SdMAUI project materials, our contribution is evidenced in the implementation

of the mobile application experience across its customer journeys and supporting platform

services. The work covers the delivery of user-facing screens, navigation, reusable controls,

localization resources, offer and membership experiences, location-aware features, digital

value journeys, and platform-specific mobile integrations.

●Mobile application implementation using a shared .NET MAUI foundation for Android and iOS.

●UI/UX implementation for login, onboarding, offers, maps, favorites, gift cards, subscriptions,

profile, support, and notification journeys.

●Business workflow implementation connecting discovery, saving, location context, digital value

actions, and ongoing engagement.

●Platform support for device location, geofencing, maps, billing-related experiences, secure

storage, dialogs, and mobile interaction patterns.

●Application enhancement foundations through reusable controls, shared resources, localized

content, and service abstractions.

Section: DIGITAL SAVINGS > Project Outcome

Digital Savings Synergy App provides a practical mobile channel for customers to discover

savings, understand participating locations, manage saved interests, access digital value

features, and remain connected to the service. Its broad workflow coverage gives the

business a foundation for customer acquisition, repeat engagement, member support, and

continued product growth.

This document is based on the verified project source and is intentionally presented at a

business level. It excludes source code, service endpoints, credentials, private data, and
